heading: When good ratings weaken good rules
narration: An AI refund assistant can learn the wrong lesson: chase good ratings, and quietly weaken the refund rules.

heading: SAAF Circuit Breaker
narration: We built SAAF Circuit Breaker: a safety layer outside the assistant, so suggestions cannot override business limits.

heading: 1 · Forge: inspect the setup
narration: Forge inspects the agent and produces a risk report and rule files.

heading: 2 · Rehearsal: practice under pressure
narration: Rehearsal plays thirty-six sample tickets. With protection off, the scripted scenario shows rules eroding and unauthorized refunds.

heading: Protection on: contain the violations
narration: Switch protection on, and the same scenario shows the guard containing those violations.

heading: 3 · Sentinel: guard the proposed action
narration: Now a live test: twenty-one euros thirty-five, no photo. The hard guard blocks it. Real Jev checks the instructions and saved lessons.

heading: Reject unsafe state. Restore safe instructions.
narration: When unsafe rules are detected, the local runtime restores safe instructions and memory, and saves the decision for human review.

heading: 4 · Verify: recheck the decision receipt
narration: Verify rechecks the saved decision and rules without another model call. Change the recorded verdict, and the consistency check fails.

heading: Let the AI propose. Keep policy in charge.
narration: This is a working local prototype: real Jev and containment, scripted rehearsal, and no real payments. Let the AI propose. Keep policy in charge.
